# systeam_project (Data Source)

Look up an existing project by name within an organization.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the project to look up.
- `organization_id` (Number) The organization the project belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `access_control_enabled` (Boolean) Whether access control is enabled for the project.
- `description` (String) The project description.
- `id` (Number) The unique identifier of the project.
